name: A chat request ticks off tasks into a shareable link
looks: A small numbered step tag ("01 - ASK IN CHAT") sits above a chat window; a plain-language request types on, then two task lines tick from pending to checked one after another beneath it, each labelled with the exact action taken. The chat closes with a short confirmation line and a result link in its own highlighted box.
build: Step tag is a fixed small pill in the corner, swapping only between scenes, not within this one. Chat message types on 20-30ms per character; each task line's checkbox fills and ticks on its own beat, 300-400ms apart, label appearing with the check. The result link box fades/lifts in last, in a contrasting highlight colour.
sound: A soft typewriter patter under the request, a clean tick on each task completing, a brighter confirm chime on the result link's arrival.
prompt: Under a small numbered step tag, type a plain-language request into a chat window, then tick off a couple of task lines one after another beneath it as the system completes each part of the job, closing with a short confirmation and a shareable result link highlighted in its own box.
